senses.sense_definition: An original model or pattern from which other similar things are copied or derived.

examples.text: The ancient temple served as the <w>archetype</w> for many later buildings in the region.
This early design is the <w>archetype</w> of all modern sports cars.

senses.sense_definition: A perfect or typical example of a particular quality or type of person or thing.

examples.text: He is the <w>archetype</w> of a successful entrepreneur, always looking for new opportunities.
The novel features a character who is the <w>archetype</w> of the brave hero.

senses.sense_definition: A universal symbol or pattern of behavior that is part of the collective human unconscious.

examples.text: Jung believed that the hero is a common <w>archetype</w> found in myths across all cultures.
Many fairy tales rely on the <w>archetype</w> of the wise old mentor to guide the protagonist.

senses.sense_definition: To represent or categorize someone or something as a specific universal type.

examples.text: The author tends to <w>archetype</w> his characters rather than giving them complex personalities.
Critics argued that the film <w>archetyped</w> the lead character as a classic villain.
